value.rationale: Completes the exact sign/equality classification for the first trivariate mixed-sign Gaussian product with two quadratic factors on the entire covariance domain, and finds an explicit unique exponent transition within the natural positive equicorrelation model. It specifies both inequality regimes rather than just a low-value counterexample; the dimension-two universal opposite inequality motivates the question.
